slides.stem:
Which expression is equivalent to

$\frac{x^2 - x - 6}{x^2 - 9} \cdot \frac{x + 3}{x^2 - 4}$

for all values of $x$ for which the expression is defined?

slides.intro: Factor all four pieces before touching anything.
slides.trapWhy: B stops canceling too early. Only the $(x - 2)$ survives.
slides.stem: Which expression is equivalent to the product shown?

slides.title: Cancel across the product
slides.body:
In a product of rational expressions, any factor upstairs cancels any matching factor downstairs, no matter which fraction it lives in.

Factor every polynomial first. The canceling is the easy part.

slides.title: When you miss one like this, Seva tells you why.
